'''Pat-aK''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] sent by the [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] to repair [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
After the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] required repairs. In Coruscant's distant history, the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] had a hand in building some of Coruscant's infrastructure, so at some point during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] reached out to the Gree for aid. Isolationists, the Gree themselves did not come. Instead, the Gree sent [[Droid/Legends|droid]] representatives to aid in the rebuilding efforts. These representatives included Pat-aK, the lead [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] droid assigned to work with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Oranda]], [[Hib-R-ak]], the subordinate droid responsible for the [[waste processing system]], [[In-iK]], the droid responsible for the power systems, and [[Nam-aK]], the droid assigned to the [[hydrosupply]].<ref name="TOR" />

Initially, the Gree droids had difficulty communicating with their [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[collaborator]]s due to their tendency to fall back on [[Gree (language)|Gree speech patterns]] when their [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] speech programming was insufficient to convey their ideas. An agent of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who had traveled to Coruscant on other business happened upon Oranda and Pat-aK attempting and failing to converse, and discerned much more about Pat-aK's troubles than Oranda did. The Republic agent determined that Pat-aK's subordinates had fallen under attack by hostile forces who had taken control of various sections of [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant's lower levels]], interrupting the repair work. The Republic agent needed to access these areas anyway in the course of their other business, and so they agreed to take on some jobs for Pat-aK and Oranda to help repair Coruscant.<ref name="TOR" />

Pat-aK sent the Republic agent, designated in the Gree language as a "black bisector," to Nam-aK. Nam-aK had been assigned to repair Coruscant's water processing systems, but Pat-aK did not inform Nam-aK that the systems were in [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] territory. The agent aided Nam-aK, In-iK, and Hib-R-aK, and in gratitude Pat-aK gave them pieces of Gree technology. Thanks to their efforts, Pat-aK and Senator Oranda ratified an official treaty between the Gree Enclave and the Republic.<ref name="TOR" />

==Characteristics==
Pat-aK and the other Gree droid ambassadors were physically similar to basic [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]], but were somewhat dissimilar in their programming. These droids spoke some Basic but fell back on Gree speech patterns of colors and geometry when trying to explain concepts that they were unable to enunciate otherwise.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pat-aK was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He appears in the Coruscant mission "Gree: Repairing Coruscant," where he and Senator Oranda ask Republic players to aid the Gree droids in repairing the planet's systems.
